segments.ch06.s0400: The Cheshire Cat was sitting on a bough of a tree a few yards off.
segments.ch06.s0410: The Cat only grinned when it saw Alice.
segments.ch06.s0420: It had very long claws and a great many teeth, so it ought to be treated with respect.
segments.ch06.s0440: It only grinned a little wider.
segments.ch06.s0450: Would you tell me, please, which way I ought to go from here?
segments.ch06.s0460: That depends a good deal on where you want to get to.
segments.ch06.s0470: I do not much care where.
segments.ch06.s0480: Then it does not matter which way you go.
segments.ch06.s0490: So long as I get somewhere.
segments.ch06.s0500: Oh, you are sure to do that, if you only walk long enough.
segments.ch06.s0510: What sort of people live about here?
segments.ch06.s0520: In that direction lives a Hatter.
segments.ch06.s0530: And in that direction lives a March Hare.
segments.ch06.s0540: Visit either you like, they are both mad.
segments.ch06.s0550: But I do not want to go among mad people.
segments.ch06.s0600: How do you know I am mad?
segments.ch06.s0610: You must be, or you would not have come here.
segments.ch06.s0620: Do you play croquet with the Queen today?
segments.ch06.s0630: I should like it very much, but I have not been invited yet.
segments.ch06.s0660: While she was looking at the place where it had been, it suddenly appeared again.
segments.ch06.s0670: By the bye, what became of the baby?
segments.ch06.s0710: She walked on, and there was the Cat again, sitting on a branch of a tree.
segments.ch06.s0720: Did you say pig, or fig?
segments.ch06.s0740: I wish you would not keep appearing and vanishing so suddenly.
segments.ch06.s0770: This time it vanished quite slowly.
segments.ch06.s0780: It began with the end of the tail, and ended with the grin.
segments.ch06.s0790: The grin remained some time after the rest of it had gone.
segments.ch06.s0800: I have often seen a cat without a grin.
segments.ch06.s0810: But a grin without a cat!
segments.ch06.s0820: It is the most curious thing I ever saw in my life!
